cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to leave out a clean towel for visitors. Should I bring my own when I come round now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very hospitable. You're learning. The guest towel, or the one that used to be mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you kept my system. When I leave, shall I hang it back on that hook or put it with the guest laundry? I don't want to undo your progress.

reason: Make A teaching behavior shape the pursuit rather than detach from the relationship, preserving concrete stakes and responsive partner contributions.
